args.summary: One device (FX-RAM-01, hostname fx-latitude-ram) shows persistent high memory usage, with RAM at or above 95% in 10 of 14 daily snapshots across the telemetry window. A second device (FX-RAM-02, hostname fx-macbook-spike) had a brief spike (2 consecutive snapshots) but is not yet considered persistent.

claims.text: Device FX-RAM-01 (fx-latitude-ram) has persistent RAM constraint: RAM at or above 95% in 10 of 14 snapshots (71% of readings), with a maximum of 3 consecutive high-usage days. It has 16 GB total RAM.
Device FX-RAM-02 (fx-macbook-spike) had a short spike: RAM at or above 95% on 2 consecutive snapshots (14% of readings), but this is flagged as not yet persistent. It has 32 GB total RAM.
One device in the fleet had too few snapshots (less than 7) for trend assessment; its current state was still checked but no trend conclusion is available.

caveats: One RAM reading per day: high usage at that moment, not proof of sustained memory pressure.
Too few snapshots for a trend on 1 device(s) (a trend needs 7). Their latest snapshot was still checked, so this says nothing about their current state.
